_notes: Independent regional system, Fairfield (Solano County). 2-hospital system. CMFA conduit issuer. Successfully recovered from earlier rating pressure: S&P had assigned 'BBB-' new issue; outlook revised from negative to stable May 29 2024 with affirmation. FY2024 revenue $862.3M (+13.6% YoY), net operating income $12.9M. Stable performer through window.
